title: S'mores Overnight Oats
markdown:
**S'mores Overnight Oats** — 1 250m

Fuel your Friday with S'mores Overnight Oats—perfect for the early birds hitting the Riverwalk. Creamy, chocolatey, and packed with 25g of protein, this breakfast is a treat that keeps you full through those stair climbs. Easy to prep the night before—just grab and go. Marshmallows and graham crackers bring the campfire vibes to your morning hustle. Perfect post-run or pre-workout fuel. Recipe: [Eating Bird Food](https://www.eatingbirdfood.com/smores-overnight-oats/)

_Ingredients:_
- ¾ cup unsweetened almond milk (or milk of choice)
- ½ cup old-fashioned rolled oats
- 1 scoop vanilla whey protein powder
- ½ Tablespoon chia seeds
- ½ teaspoon vanilla extract
- pinch of sea salt
- 6  mini marshmallows (chopped)
- 3  Simple Mills Honey Graham Sweet Thins (crushed, about 1 Tablespoon, or regular graham crackers)
- ½ Tablespoon mini chocolate chips
- crushed graham crackers
- mini marshmallows
- mini chocolate chips

_Method:_
1. Add almond milk, oats, protein powder, chia seeds, vanilla and salt to a jar or bowl. Stir well until fully combined.
2. Stir in the mini marshmallows, crushed graham crackers and chocolate chips.
3. Cover and refrigerate overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
4. Before serving, top with extra graham crackers, marshmallows and chocolate chips, if desired.
